posts.title: What Do You Sell When AI Can Build the Website?
posts.description: I used to make good money building websites. Years later, after my online business declined, I was back on LinkedIn applying for jobs—and watching AI produce work I used to charge for. Here’s what that experience taught me about the skills, services and judgement worth developing next. Source

posts.title: Financial Freedom: I Built the Income Before I Understood the Risk
posts.description: In September 2015, my AdSense income matched my full-time salary. By December, it was bringing in nearly double. I remember the satisfaction of discovering that something I had built could earn while I was doing something else. Source

posts.title: How I Built a $1 Million+ Passive Income Business
posts.description: The SEO, email marketing and lead-generation engine behind a $1M+ affiliate business—and the hard lessons from its rise and fall. Source
